versions.localizedDescription:
> **Project rename — 21 October 2026:** RewindBox is the independent iOS/iPadOS fork maintained by TarbleFR, based on [NeoStation by misobadev](https://github.com/misobadev/neostation-frontend). Please use [RewindBox Issues](https://github.com/TarbleFR/RewindBox/issues) for this fork, not the upstream support server. Original authorship and licenses remain unchanged.
>
> This historical release has not been rebuilt. Its title and download filenames now use RewindBox, but the original signed IPA still shows its original installed name and Files folder. All pre-existing binary, source and license asset bytes and SHA-256 digests are unchanged. A new checksum list covers the renamed files; the original checksum record is retained separately.

# RewindBox 0.0.8 🎮

This update expands cheat support, brings more immersive touch controls and fixes several stability issues.

- **Expanded unified cheat catalogue:** more sources for RetroArch cores, arcade games, PS2, PS3, GameCube and Wii, available through a single catalogue download.
- **Simpler cheat management:** compatible cheats appear automatically for the detected game, with individual on/off switches and support for importing your own files. Matching takes available region and version identifiers into account.
- **Faster cheat searches:** improved indexing and duplicate handling. PS2 gameplay cheats are presented separately from graphical patches.
- **More immersive touch controls:** visible button presses on compatible skins, with improved touch handling and control layouts.
- **Scraping crash fixed:** reduced memory usage when processing large game files, resolving the reported crash on iPhone 15 Pro Max.
- **Improved stability:** fixes for game startup, skins, shaders and game closing.
- **Easier first launch:** skip the initial game-folder selection and add your games later.

Cheat availability depends on the game, region and revision. Updated credits and third-party notices are also included.

📦 Download **RewindBox-0.0.8.ipa** below and install it with your usual sideloading tool.

[Source credits](https://github.com/TarbleFR/RewindBox/blob/0.0.8/docs/CHEAT_CATALOG_SOURCES.md) · [Licenses and notices](https://github.com/TarbleFR/RewindBox/releases/download/0.0.8/RewindBox-0.0.8-Licenses-and-Notices.zip) · [Source and packaging details](https://github.com/TarbleFR/RewindBox/blob/0.0.8/docs/RELEASE_0.0.8_SOURCE_MANIFEST.md)
